title: Remote MCP OAuth path format, generated surface, and write inventory guard

phases.objective: Keep future OpenAPI, Custom GPT surface, OAuth, and Remote MCP write paths fail-closed, generated-artifact synchronized, and covered by deterministic local and CI contracts without activating write scopes.

e2e_journeys.actor: Repository maintainer and deterministic CI guard
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A changed OpenAPI, OAuth, Custom GPT surface, migration, route, or write-inventory artifact is evaluated by the local path guard and its required contract tests.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Every source operation is marker-covered or explicitly excluded, generated registries match their source fingerprints, write inventory remains classified with activation disabled, and parity contracts pass.
steps: Load the canonical OpenAPI source, v2 Custom GPT surface registry, operation registry, and write-scope inventory.
Check source-operation marker and exclusion coverage against the historical baseline so a new unmarked path fails closed.
Regenerate and compare operation and surface artifacts without applying migrations or calling providers.
Run OAuth token exchange, activation coverage, mutation governance, and shared-policy parity fixtures.
Report deterministic pass or fail evidence with no write-scope activation and no secret values.
assertions: A new source OpenAPI operation requires a surface marker or a bounded exclusion record.
Operation registry and generated artifacts must match the current source fingerprint.
unclassified_write_route_count remains zero and write activation remains disabled.
Tenant GPT OAuth token exchange remains PKCE S256-bound and testable without a live provider or database migration.
Internal OAuth, SSO, and scope-catalog ledgers remain outside tenant or admin activation surfaces.
All checks are deterministic, bounded, and secret-free.

phases.objective: Observe the guard and external readiness contracts on an exact staging candidate without enabling provider or internal writes.
Exercise stale artifacts, concurrent refresh, ingress drift, and path-registry conflicts with bounded recovery evidence.
Run the exact read-only OAuth and MCP client canaries against an authorized non-production endpoint.
Require independent approval, production ingress attestation, live database readiness, and rollback evidence before any production advertisement or write activation.
